reason: A web-interface companion plugin that adds a draggable animated cat or dog overlay, reflects conversation activity, and provides configurable visual and text interactions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加可拖动的猫狗悬浮伙伴，根据会话状态显示表情、短句和交互按钮。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable cat or dog companion to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with conversation-aware expressions, short messages, and configurable interactions.

capabilities: Displays a draggable animated mascot overlay in the web interface
Reflects current conversation states with expressions and status text
Can optionally request short text from the current default model when enabled
